fields.statement: At 94281d07 I read the diff: CheckRequest gains SkipReference (json skip_reference), runCheck leaves DocsWant, Commands and Docs unset when it is true, run code-check's checkIn passes SkipReference: true, and the only other caller (health) and plain rhiza check keep the default false, so both rules stay for rhiza check and make self-check. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... passed, including TestCheckSkipReference (default check has 2 fail findings, on docs/reference/cli.md and README.md; skip_reference has 0). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(review-code-check|describe-golden)$' passed: review-code-check makes docs/reference stale and a README naming rhiza no-such-command, sees rhiza check fail naming both, then rhiza run code-check pass with exit 0 and neither in its output; describe-golden includes skip_reference.
